biological.citation: Cell-type-specific role for nucleus accumbens neuroligin-2 in depression and stress susceptibility (PMID: 29339486)
biological.summary: NLGN2 expression is reduced in the nucleus accumbens of patients with major depressive disorder. Chronic social defeat stress lowers Nlgn2 selectively in D1-positive cells of stress-susceptible mice. Cell-type-specific knockdown gave opposite effects: D1 knockdown promoted subordination and stress susceptibility, while D2 knockdown promoted active defensive behavior.

biological.citation: A neuroligin-2-YAP axis regulates progression of pancreatic intraepithelial neoplasia (PMID: 38413734)
biological.summary: NLGN2 is expressed in pancreatic exocrine cells and localizes to tight junctions in acinar cells. It is lost in high-grade PanINs and many advanced PDACs. NLGN2 is needed to form the PALS1/PATJ complex, which reduces YAP function and induces contact inhibition and epithelial polarity.

biological.citation: Physical Interactions and Functional Relationships of Neuroligin 2 and Midbrain Serotonin Transporters (PMID: 26793096)
biological.summary: NLGN2 co-immunoprecipitates with SERT in mouse midbrain, together with NRXN and gephyrin. The interaction is Ca2+-independent, consistent with a cis interaction in somatodendritic compartments, and is absent in hippocampus. Tph2 and Nlgn2 mRNA are co-expressed in dorsal raphe. Nlgn2 null mice show reduced SERT expression and function, reduced raphe 5-HT neuron excitability, loss of GABAA IPSCs, increased 5-HT1A autoreceptor sensitivity, and behavioral changes.

biological.citation: Identification and functional characterization of rare mutations of the neuroligin-2 gene (NLGN2) associated with schizophrenia (PMID: 21551456)
biological.summary: Sequencing NLGN2 found 19 variants, including six rare missense mutations. The R215H mutant is a loss-of-function variant for GABAergic synaptogenesis in cell assays and electrophysiology. It is retained in the ER and not trafficked to the cell membrane. Incomplete penetrance was seen in the family.

biological.citation: Neuroligin 2 deletion alters inhibitory synapse function and anxiety-associated neuronal activation in the amygdala (PMID: 26142252)
biological.summary: Nlgn2 is present at most inhibitory synapses in the basal amygdala. Its deletion disrupts perisomatic postsynaptic structures and impairs inhibitory transmission onto projection neurons. Knockout mice show anxiety and exaggerated cFOS induction in CaMKII-positive projection neurons.

biological.citation: GABAergic deficits and schizophrenia-like behaviors in a mouse model carrying patient-derived neuroligin-2 R215H mutation (PMID: 29859117)
biological.summary: R215H knock-in mice show a marked loss of NL2 protein in vivo, reduced GABAergic transmission, and impaired hippocampal activation. They display anxiety-like behavior, impaired PPI, cognitive deficits, and abnormal stress responses, modeling schizophrenia-like phenotypes.

biological.citation: Chronic stress induces depression through MDGA1-Neuroligin2 mediated suppression of inhibitory synapses in the lateral habenula (PMID: 39897557)
biological.summary: MDGA1 and Nlgn2 interact selectively in the lateral habenula, and the interaction increases after chronic restraint stress. An Nlgn2 variant unable to bind MDGA1 increases GABAergic transmission and synapse density and confers resistance to stress-induced depressive behaviors. MDGA1 therefore suppresses Nlgn2-mediated inhibitory synapse formation.

biological.citation: Whole-genome expression analysis reveals genes associated with treatment response to escitalopram in major depression (PMID: 27461515)
biological.summary: In peripheral blood expression profiling, baseline NLGN2 expression predicted escitalopram treatment outcome. It distinguished low-dose responders from treatment-resistant patients.

biological.citation: PSD-95 deficiency alters GABAergic inhibition in the prefrontal cortex (PMID: 32818520)
biological.summary: In PSD-95+/- mice, NLGN2 is upregulated and shows increased trafficking, together with reduced GSK3β activity (tyr-216 phosphorylation). This is associated with enhanced GABAergic inhibition in the mPFC, linking NLGN2 to the PSD-95/GSK3β regulation of inhibitory synapses.

biological.citation: Expression and structural analysis of human neuroligin 2 and neuroligin 3 implicated in autism spectrum disorders (PMID: 36479216)
biological.summary: Cryo-EM structures of human NLGN2 and NLGN3 were solved. The two protomers in each homodimer are rotated relative to each other, which may influence interactions with MDGAs. Expression of NLGN2 and NLGN3 was also compared across brain regions and in a streptozotocin-induced maternal diabetes ASD mouse model.
